summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Bulk CSV Import feature for Residents & Attendings. All 17 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed including wizard flow, file upload, preview, import, duplicate detection, error handling, and navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings.jsx line 29: Typo in state variable name 'setAtttendings' should be 'setAttendings' (3 t's instead of 2) - inherited from previous iterations
seed_data_creation: Multiple test residents and attendings created during testing with UI_* and TEST_* prefixes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk Import feature is fully functional. All wizard steps work correctly: Upload, Preview, Importing, Complete. Entity type switching (Residents/Attendings) works. Template download works. File upload via click and drag-drop works. Preview shows correct valid/error/duplicate counts. Error messages are clear (e.g., 'Missing required headers: name, email', 'Invalid email format'). Duplicate detection by email works correctly. Skip duplicates checkbox works. Cancel returns to upload step. Import Another File resets wizard. View Residents/Attendings navigates correctly.
